title: Ceruledge 098/193 Holo Rare Paldea Evolved S&V Pokemon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Ceruledge 098/193 Holo Rare Paldea Evolved Pokémon TCG card from the Scarlet & Violet - Paldea Evolved set. This English-language card features Psychic attributes and a standard card size, manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. As a Holo card, it has a shiny finish and belongs to the Pokémon TCG game category. It is a sought-after collectible for fans and collectors of the Pokémon trading card game.
